metadata.label: Inventory adjusted Production Value Index (PVI). Chain index, 2021=100, by industrial classification NACE Rev.2. Quarter 2015K1-2025K4
note:
Data marked with .. includes classified information or missing data.  
  
The publication of the inventory adjusted production value index has ceased. Statistics with similar content are available in the product (https://www.scb.se/nv0124-en)[Quarterly economic statistics], where it is referred to as the private sector value added.  
  
  
Methodological changes  
  
The time series 2010–2014 has been recalculated at the publication of reference month September 2017.  
  
2024-08-20: New decision-making rules have been introduced for the classification of head offices with extensive operations abroad or other Swedish corporate entities. The implementation will take place gradually, starting from the reference year 2022. As a result of the new decision-making rules, some large head offices have been reclassified as independent units and instead of support activities are regarded as primary activities. These kind-of-activity units are now included in the population with industry 70.1 head office activities. The change affects all aggregates in the statistics, which include industry 70.1.  
  
2024-05-21: When the reference quarter 1 2024 is published, the base year is changed to 2021. This means that the average of the quartly indices in 2021 is 100 (index 2021=100).  
  
2024-11-21: When publishing the reference quarter 3 2024, changes are implemented that aim to increase the quality of the statistics. The changes involve revisions, in most cases small, from April 2018 to August 2024 in several industries and aggregates. Part of this improvement is due to the enhancement of methods for constant price calculations from January 2022 and onwards, which affect the industries of Education (P), Human health and social work activities (Q), Arts, entertainment and recreation (R) and Other service activities (S) and all aggregates that include these activities.  
  
  
Revisions  
  
2025-02-20: In connection with the publication of the reference quarter 4 2024, the statistics have been corrected for the 2nd and 3rd quarter 2024 because of an error was discovered in the calculation of statistics. The error stems from the model calculation of the turnover of so-called annual filers, i.e. companies that, due to their turnover size, only need to declare VAT annually. The correction affects all industries.  
  
2025-02-20: In connection with the publication of the reference quarter 4 2024, the statistics for sales and repair establishments for motor vehicles and motorcycles (NACE 45) and professional, scientific and technical companies (NACE M), as well as all aggregates where these industries are included, will be revised back to 2nd quarter 2023. This is because new data has been received by Statistics Sweden.  
  
2025-05-21: In connection with the publication of Q1 2025, a methodological change will be introduced regarding the handling of VAT data when used as a source of turnover. The change will entail revisions from Q2 2019 onwards, in most cases very small and not sufficient to affect published statistical values.
